summary:
Stream w5si (worktree fnd/w5si from c23c5e76, nothing committed or pushed, the main checkout untouched, no box time used). SI-001 now reads every edge from a data file, v2/ecad/tools/pcb_edge_rates.yaml. It holds 6 interface records, 58 driver families and 29 far ends. Each record carries its document, the words quoted from it, conditions, applicability and the verification still owed; the file's header holds the schema and session decisions ER-D1 to ER-D12.

How a net's edge is decided, in edge_length.py:
- **A covered class entry** takes its interface record's edge.
- **Otherwise the drivers on the net are asked:** every U or Q part is looked up by the part number at the start of its value field, never an order code. A maker's IBIS model is read per pin by the new tools/ibis_read.py (fastest driven 20 to 80 percent transition, open drains fall only, inputs drive nothing).
- **Beyond the board:** a connector or passive-switch pin takes its far end. A kit board-to-board net is read from the continued boards' own committed netlists, pin by pin. A net also takes the drivers one series resistor away.
- **A part with no record leaves its net UNDECIDED and is named.**
- **Only a published minimum counts as a figure.** A published typical or maximum is refused; where a maker publishes none, the instantaneous bound (0 ns) stands in, marked as a bound.
- **Bound versus maker:** a layout-bound net that no maker's figure on it holds is named BOUND_DECIDES and keeps the reading INCONCLUSIVE. One a maker's figure holds is the maker's.
- **A record contradicted by its own IBIS file FAILs the reading.**

Documents: 13 maker IBIS models are filed (12 TI fetched directly; ST's STM32H743 LQFP100 file taken through Wayback because st.com refuses this host), each with a sources.txt and a vendor-status.txt line. Tests: 10 new, 28 in test_edge_length; 201 pass across the affected test files in the worktree. The same 28 pass on an extract of fnd/r8int6 (053a0524), and all four drafts apply on that tree.

Results on the committed netlists: 753 of the 765 nets that had no decided edge are now decided. Every reading stays INCONCLUSIVE, now for named reasons:
- 241 nets are held only by a bound. None of them decides feasibility: each has a schematic answer that does not depend on its edge.
- 83 layout-bound nets are held by makers' own figures. These are real engineering findings: board B's voters and supervisor lines, its CAN lines and heartbeats, and the kit I2C bus and EXP_INT, at 0.11 to 0.45 ns (critical lengths 2.6 to 10.5 mm).

Side findings, drafted not edited: board B's table has stale declarations (SW?_IN and SW?_O? say "voter" but are RF switch ports; BOB is the Ethernet Bob Smith termination), and gen_pcb_b3.py puts the RF ports in the USB class and GNSS_RF_IN in none.

Config input: pcb_edge_rates.yaml and the IBIS files must be committed before rules_status or rules_render run, or every SI-001 reading reads CONFIG_CHANGED.

decisions: All decisions below are SESSION decisions (stream w5si, 27 September 2026) under the owner's standing rule of 26 September 2026, not the owner's. Each is recorded with its reason and reversal in the pcb_edge_rates.yaml header or in the draft that carries it

ER-D1: the data file is the declaration of every edge, and a board table's own rise_ns must agree with it. Why: a board table or a code constant has no place for conditions, applicability or owed verification. Reverse: restore edge_length.EDGE_SOURCES as a constant
ER-D2: a driver is a U (IC or module) or Q (transistor) part, and a connector's pin is its far side; a part with no record leaves its net UNDECIDED, named. Reverse: edge_length.DRIVER_PREFIXES
ER-D3: a part is recognised by the part number at the start of its value field, never by an order code (the third review, section 5)
ER-D4: the fastest candidate on a net decides (the worst case)

ER-D5: from an IBIS model, take the fastest driven 20 to 80 percent transition over admitted models and all three corners, unstretched; an open drain drives only its fall. Caveat: a model describes the die the maker modelled. Reverse: ibis_read.model_edge
ER-D6: a net takes the drivers one two-pin series resistor away, once
ER-D7: a far-end family beyond the kit contributes its fastest pin; a board of the set that the net continues onto is instead read pin by pin from its own netlist

ER-D8: only a published MINIMUM is an edge; a typical or maximum is refused. Where no maker figure or model is held, the bound is instantaneous (0 ns), which can only turn a verdict against the design
ER-D9: a layout-bound net that no maker's figure on it holds is BOUND_DECIDES and holds the reading INCONCLUSIVE (TSN-D18 unchanged)
ER-D10: firmware-set drive and slew (STM32H743 OSPEEDR, RP2040 SLEWFAST, CM5 drive and slew) are taken at their fastest setting, since HW-FW-CONTRACT records no obligation that slows them
ER-D11: the STM32H743's HSLV pins at 3.3 V are read with the io8_ft 3.3 V models (DS12110 Table 53 covers every FT I/O with HSLV off)
ER-D12: a bound that decides nothing counts as decided (answered nets, maker-held nets). Reverse: count MODEL and BOUND basis nets as undecided in schematic_result
W5SI-D1 (draft): board B's SKY13351 ports, card RF lines and GNSS_RF_IN are declared RF and put in the RF (50 ohm) class
W5SI-D2 (draft): board B's BOB is declared LOW_SPEED_OR_DC as the Ethernet magnetics' Bob Smith termination
Process choice: HW-FW-CONTRACT.md is not cited by any record (a working document would stale every reading on each edit); bound records cite maker documents or state no_document
open_items: CONFIG INPUT: commit v2/ecad/tools/pcb_edge_rates.yaml and v2/vendor/{ti,st}/ibis/ BEFORE rules_status and rules_render, apply the four drafts in order, then re-take SI-001 on all six boards together (continuations read every board's declared netlist)

Q1, power-stage nodes (82 nets, bound-decided). What length holds each gate, bootstrap and switch node, and which rule sets it? No registry rule states one. Recommended: a per-stage model from driver resistance and FET charge, a power-loop length rule, then edge_allow declarations naming it. Needs a power-stage layout review
Q2, oscillator nodes (19 nets). CLK-001 should state a maximum node length per crystal; declarations then name it

Q3, drivers whose makers publish no edge (114 on-board and cable nets). Per net, choose a series resistor at the driver, a firmware slew obligation (a layer 5 HW-FW-CONTRACT row), or a declared length once the edge is measured

Q4, board B's control plane, CAN and heartbeats (maker-held, 0.11 to 0.45 ns, critical 2.6 to 10.5 mm on a 530 mm board). Should each LVC and STM32 output driving a long run get a series source resistor, and should the STM32 outputs be held at OSPEEDR 00 (6.70 ns, about 156 mm)? Which inputs are edge-sensitive (double clocking) sets the urgency. Owed to board B's author as a gen_sch_b.py change

Q5, the kit I2C bus and EXP_INT (maker-held). They are transmission lines for their sub-nanosecond pull-downs (STM32H743 I2C1 0.451 ns, PCA9555 INT 0.121 ns, ADS1115 SDA 0.786 ns) over about 1.5 m of copper and 490 mm of ribbon. Fold into SC-HF-02: a firmware obligation for the STM32 I2C1 pins (Fm+ pad or OSPEEDR 00), UM10204 series resistors, and the TCA9517A's own edges; bench check V-K0x

Q6: 75 nets with no signal-class declaration (A 38, B 8, C 4, D 8, P 17) need board-table entries. Not drafted because fnd/r8int6 rewrites boards/*.json; the lists are in drafts/w5si/readings/bound_decides.txt

Q7: the makers' IBIS models this runner could not fetch (Nexperia 74LVC1G157, Diodes 74LVC1G17 and 74LVC1G34, Microchip KSZ9897R, Winbond W25Q16JV) need a browser fetch, no login required. They would narrow bounds that currently decide no feasibility

Q8, publication (the owner's call): TI's IBIS headers say 'Unauthorized reproduction and/or distribution is strictly prohibited', and ST's carry a copyright. They are filed under v2/vendor/README.md's standing terms (maker's property, takedown on request), as the datasheets are. If they are withheld, those records read UNDECIDED (fail closed)

Instrument limits: GNSS_ANT is declared a rail (the antenna bias) and so leaves SI-001's signal set although it is also an RF line (RF-001 covers it). The routed half (edge_length_routed, which decides no rule) still reads the board tables' rise_ns and should adopt the data file when the layout gate adopts it. Continuations assume the same net name on each board, and the test checks that
The vast.ai box was not used: no KiCad step was needed and nothing was spent
commit_subject: feat(rules): SI-001 reads each driver's edge from a data file of makers' IBIS models, published minimums and stated bounds, and names every net a bound decides [MESHSAT-1357]
commit_body:
Layer 9, rule SI-001 (third checkpoint review, sections 5 and 6: never insert a convenient edge; record a justified
bound or model, its applicability and the verification owed; keep a feasibility decision open where the bound decides
it). Prototype design work, nothing built or measured.

- tools/pcb_edge_rates.yaml (new, a CONFIGURATION INPUT of the edge_length verdict, recorded by sha): 6 interface
  records (the USB 2.0 minimums that were EDGE_SOURCES; instantaneous bounds for board B's controlled links, RF lines,
  power-stage and oscillator nodes), 58 driver families matched by the part number at the start of the netlist value
  (never an order code), 29 far ends. Each record carries document, quoted words, conditions, applicability and
  verification owed. Session decisions ER-D1 to ER-D12 are in its header.
- tools/ibis_read.py (new): a maker's IBIS model read per pin, giving the fastest driven 20 to 80 percent transition
  over the admitted models and corners; open drains fall only, inputs drive nothing.
- tools/edge_length.py: per-net driver resolution (interface record, else U and Q families per pin, far ends, one
  series resistor away, continued boards read pin by pin from their own netlists). A driver with no record leaves the
  net UNDECIDED. A published typical or maximum is refused as an edge. A record its own IBIS file contradicts FAILs.
  A layout-bound net no maker figure holds is BOUND_DECIDES and stays INCONCLUSIVE. The verdict records the data file,
  cited documents and continued netlists by sha.
- tests/test_edge_length.py: 10 new tests, 28 in the file (fixtures both ways, the reader, maker-held versus
  bound-decided, refusals, far ends, series hop, continuations, the real data file held against its documents, models
  and the committed netlists).
- v2/vendor/ti/ibis (12 TI models) and v2/vendor/st/ibis (ST STM32H743 LQFP100 via Wayback), with sources.txt and
  vendor-status.txt lines.

Readings on the committed netlists at c23c5e76 (nets decided, before then after): A 6 then 82, B 30 then 553,
C 4 then 33, D 20 then 39, E 4 then 41, P 0 then 5. Undecided: 114 then 38, 532 then 9, 33 then 4, 27 then 8, 37 then
0, 22 then 17. What remains undecided is 75 nets with no class declaration and board B's BOB. All six readings stay
INCONCLUSIVE, now for named reasons.

241 nets are held only by a bound, and none of them decides feasibility: each has an answer independent of its edge.
83 are held by makers' own figures: board B's voters, supervisor, CAN and heartbeat lines at 0.11 to 0.45 ns, the kit
I2C bus and EXP_INT, and board D's HUB_DM4 and HUB_DP4.

Drafts in drafts/w5si/, applied by the integrator: rules_status CONFIG_INPUTS for edge_length, SOURCES.yaml rows for
the IBIS models, board B declarations and RF classes (W5SI-D1, W5SI-D2), and SI-001's coverage note and remediation.
